description: This Rust source file defines structures and functions for extracting and processing HTTP request information, including handling different content types like URL-encoded and multipart form data, within an Actix-web server context.

classes.name: RequestInfo
classes.description: Holds detailed information about an HTTP request, including method, path, headers, parameters, uploaded files, client IP, authentication info, and related application state.

classes.name: ExecutionContext
classes.description: Encapsulates a request and its associated variables, providing methods for cloning and forking execution contexts.

methods.name: RequestInfo::new
methods.description: Creates a new RequestInfo instance with provided request data.

methods.name: ExecutionContext::new
methods.description: Initializes a new execution context from a RequestInfo.

methods.name: ExecutionContext::fork
methods.description: Creates a forked copy of the current execution context, duplicating variables.

methods.name: ExecutionContext::fork_with_variables
methods.description: Creates a forked execution context with specified variables.

methods.name: extract_request_info
methods.description: Asynchronously extracts detailed request information from an Actix-web ServiceRequest, including handling different content types.

methods.name: extract_post_data
methods.description: Asynchronously extracts POST data, handling URL-encoded, multipart, or raw body content.

methods.name: extract_urlencoded_post_variables
methods.description: Parses URL-encoded form data from the request.

methods.name: extract_multipart_post_data
methods.description: Parses multipart form data, extracting fields and files.

methods.name: extract_text
methods.description: Reads and converts a form field to a UTF-8 string.

methods.name: extract_file
methods.description: Extracts a file upload into a temporary file.

methods.name: is_file_field_empty
methods.description: Checks if an uploaded file field is empty or contains no data.
